comparisons.name: title-bar-light
comparisons.description: The top 25 pt of the Photo Booth window, Aqua: the 22 pt title bar with the window controls and the title, and under it the 3 pt of the stage above the first row of previews. The nine previews are four fifths of the window; they show the camera in the capture and an abstract placeholder here, which takes nothing from those pictures, so the whole window is not compared (the harness does not accept a comparison with more than three quarters masked). Nothing is masked here. Text is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: bar-light
comparisons.description: The bottom 63 pt of the Photo Booth window, Aqua: the 3 pt of the stage under the last row of previews and the 60 pt bar with the page control on the window's centre and the Effects button. Nothing is masked.

comparisons.name: stage-geometry-light
comparisons.description: The stage with the Effects browser, Aqua: its 720 by 480 pt, and the stage's own colour in the 3 pt gaps around and between the nine previews, which is where the captures have them (columns from x 3, 242 and 481 pt, rows from y 25, 184 and 343 pt of the window). The previews themselves are not compared: they are placeholders.

comparisons.name: title-bar-dark
comparisons.description: The top 25 pt of the Photo Booth window, Dark Aqua: the same crop as title-bar-light.

comparisons.name: bar-dark
comparisons.description: The bottom 63 pt of the Photo Booth window, Dark Aqua: the same crop as bar-light.

comparisons.name: stage-geometry-dark
comparisons.description: The stage with the Effects browser, Dark Aqua: the same size and the same gaps in the same colour as stage-geometry-light; the stage does not change with the appearance.
